definitions.explanation: Made from iron or steel. Used as a modifier to describe objects crafted from iron.

examples.japanese: {鉄製|てつせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought an iron frying pan.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鉄製|てつせい}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧。
examples.english: This gate is heavy because it's made of iron.

examples.japanese: {鉄製|てつせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{鉄製|てつせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{錆|さ}びて→錆びる：07412_sabiru⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧な⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧になっていた。
examples.english: The old iron staircase had rusted and become dangerous.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧ (iron) + ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ (made of). The suffix ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ is highly productive and attaches to material names to indicate what something is made from. Understanding this pattern unlocks many similar compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄製|てつせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧: iron frying pan
- {鉄製|てつせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧: iron gate
- {鉄製|てつせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{柵|さく}→柵：13103_saku⟧: iron fence
- {鉄製|てつせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: iron pot

SIMILAR PATTERN (⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ compounds):
- ⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧: made of wood
- ⟦{金属製|きんぞくせい}→金属製：28457_kinzokusei⟧: made of metal
- ⟦{革製|かわせい}→革製：26255_kawasei⟧: made of leather
- {陶製|とうせい}: made of ceramic
- {銅製|どうせい}: made of copper
- ⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made of plastic
